text: Street scene. A faint gray rectangle background, 780 by 480, at 400, 250, called Street.
The road: a black rectangle zone named Road, 780 wide and 110 tall, at 400, 435.
Draw a blue rectangle named Bus, 200 wide and 70 tall, at 300, 330.
Wheel1, a tiny black circle at 240, 372, and Wheel2, a tiny black circle at 360, 372.
group Bus, Wheel1 and Wheel2 as Coach
Bus stop sign: a small red circle named Sign at 520, 240.
its pole: a gray rectangle 8 wide and 80 tall named Pole, two px below Sign
Group Sign and Pole as Stop.
Three small yellow squares in a row above Bus.
how many yellow squares are there on the street?
Add a large white ellipse named Cloud in the top left.
and a medium white ellipse Cloud2 right of Cloud, thirty px away
Sun: a medium yellow circle in the top right, named Sun.
Is Cloud2 left of Sun?
a person waiting: a small orange circle named Head at 640, 270
Body: an orange rectangle 20 wide and 50 tall named Body 2 px below Head
group Head and Body as Rider
Make Cloud2 gray, it's going to rain.
which shape sits highest on the street?
Connect Head to Sign with a dotted line.
Write "Route 7" above Coach, small.
